Warn when a living index has stopped being current

Source: R/climate_indices.R
warn_if_stale.Rd

A fresh download of a stale file is still stale. This checks the data rather than the cache: if a series that is supposed to keep growing ends well before now, that is worth knowing whether the cause is a cache, a provider pause, or a publication lag.

Usage

warn_if_stale(series, index, entry)

Arguments

series

the parsed monthly series

index

the index name

entry

the catalog entry

Value

invisibly NULL
